verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe the dot as an always-on agent that runs in the cloud on its own computer and keeps working while your computer is off. It can run background agents in parallel, take recurring scheduled instructions (e.g. 'each weekday at 9 AM for four weeks'), and monitor a Slack channel to prepare bug fixes. The docs also reference scheduled runs and pause controls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and dedicated documentation of how schedules and triggers are configured and managed (scheduling appears mainly through example prompts).
